title: figma-developer-mcp (Framelink Figma MCP) command injection in get_figma_data (CVE-2025-53967)
summary: figma-developer-mcp before 0.6.3 passes unsanitized input (e.g. the `fileKey` argument) into a shell `curl` invocation inside its fetchWithRetry fallback, allowing an attacker to inject arbitrary operating system commands via shell metacharacters. Exploitable by a crafted request with network access to the MCP interface, or indirectly via prompt injection.
